title: Chasing Butterflies at Every Age
content: Children chase butterflies, and for them catching one is everything. Adults still chase, only the butterflies have changed. Young people wonder if this is a joke. They hope to earn money. Girls chase too, but chasing stops. Boys warn girls not to chase. They don't listen. But they know that for them, this is the world. If they get older and wiser, they'll understand.
raw_text: Bache butterfly ke piche jaye hai. Unke liye vo titli pakadna hi sab kuch hai. Achivement hai. Youth sochte hai ky bakwas hai. Ye title bech ke kuch kama sakenge ky. Paise ajaye hai. Ladkiyo ke piche bhagte hai. Bhag abhi bhi rahy hai bs titliya badal gai hai. Bude batate hai ki beta ye titliyo ke piche mat jao. Pr sunte nai. Q? Qki unke liye to vhi duniya hai. Agar une budho ki aakhe samaz miljaye to pata chale.
